items.original_title: Anthropic's Opus 5 blows past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark designed to measure real intelligence
items.title_en: Anthropic's Opus 5 blows past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark designed to measure real intelligence
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2 percent on ARC-AGI-3, nearly quadrupling GPT-5.6 Sol's previous record of 7.8 percent. items.title_zh: Anthropic的Opus 5超越Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol的真实智能基准
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's Opus 5 在用于测试真实智能的基准测试中表现突出，得分达到了30.2%，并独立形成反思方程，这是其他模型未曾达到的水平，展现出更强的逻辑推理能力。
